page.layout: One blank page, no printed text. Only handwritten inscriptions, a library stamp and shelf marks.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. Omitted as not printed: the red stamp "Staatl. Bibliothek Regensburg", the shelf marks "6.4.16" (top left and bottom left), and the handwritten inscriptions (ownership note "Sum Reineri Bachoffy Echtÿ", a date "Anno 1580" with a "189" mark above it, and the motto "Amici mores noueris, non oderis"). The handwriting is an ownership inscription by a later hand, not part of the printed book.
